### Fixed
- **`components.klaus-gateway.versionRange` is `1.x`** (giantswarm/klaus-gateway#234, giantswarm/giantswarm#37705 wave 1c): the 4.x roster still selected `0.x`, the klaus-gateway that speaks REST to the 0.10 controller — against this line's controller GRPCRoute (its `klausGateway.a2a.url` is already the `grpc://` target) a 0.x gateway gets `404`s for every REST path. klaus-gateway 1.x is the kagent API v2 client (A2A v1 over gRPC, AgentTemplate discovery, one AgentInstance per thread); the customer BOM pins `1.0.2`; `make verify-components` asserts the range. **No installation acts**: `components.klaus-gateway` is off by default, and the one 4.x installation runs its gateway outside the chart. The 3.x meta chart keeps `0.x`.
